The Stern switch matrix identifies D15 as the upper-right flipper button. The exact VPX embedded script asserts switch 86 from RightFlipperKey and registers Q14 through solURFlipper; this is cabinet hardware and intentionally has no playfield coordinate.

The Stern switch matrix calls D16 the upper-right flipper end-of-stroke contact and the manual establishes its normally-closed physical wiring. The embedded script does not assert switch 85; the exact VPX RightFlipper2 center is used only as the disclosed assembly projection because the table has no separate EOS object.

mechanisms.behavior: The drain feeds a four-ball trough. From drain to shooter, the embedded VPX script extracted from the retained exact table orders occupied switches 18, 19, 20, and 21; switch 22 is the stack/jam opto. Output 1 ejects the shooter-side ball and the script pulses switch 22 as the ball leaves.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough and up-kicker

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 23 reports a ball in the shooter lane. Output 2 fires the automatic plunger to launch it.
mechanisms.label: Auto-launch assembly

mechanisms.behavior: A ball entering the Doc Ock hole closes switch 36. Output 4 ejects it toward the playfield.
mechanisms.label: Doc Ock vertical up-kicker

mechanisms.behavior: Output 3 enables the Doc Ock playfield magnet. The embedded VPX script extracted from the retained exact table binds the magnet directly to this modulated output.
mechanisms.label: Doc Ock magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Output 5 drives a relay for the 24 VAC synchronous motor and driver disc. Each activation advances the toy between its two limit positions; switches 57 and 58 report down and up, and target opto 63 is available in the exposed position.
mechanisms.label: Doc Ock motorized gate and target

mechanisms.behavior: A ball entering the Sandman hole closes switch 59. Output 12 ejects it toward the playfield.
mechanisms.label: Sandman vertical up-kicker

mechanisms.behavior: Output 13 drives a relay for the synchronous motor and driver disc. Each activation advances the assembly between down and up; switches 53 and 54 report those limits, and target opto 42 is exposed in the playable position.
mechanisms.label: Sandman motorized gate and target

mechanisms.behavior: Output 20 toggles the three-target bank between its lowered/playable and raised positions. Switches 9-11 are the individual target contacts; switches 49 and 50 report down and up. The embedded VPX script extracted from the retained exact table sets switch 50 when raising the bank and switch 49 when lowering it.
mechanisms.label: Sandman motorized 3-bank

mechanisms.behavior: Output 7 directly opens and closes the left control gate in the embedded VPX script extracted from the retained exact table.
mechanisms.label: Left magnetic control gate

mechanisms.behavior: Output 8 directly opens and closes the right control gate in the embedded VPX script extracted from the retained exact table.
mechanisms.label: Right magnetic control gate

mechanisms.behavior: Output 22 selects the loop-diverter route. In the embedded VPX script extracted from the retained exact table, energizing the output raises the diverter from its dropped default and de-energizing it drops the diverter.
mechanisms.label: Loop diverter

mechanisms.behavior: The left cabinet button is public switch 84 and the normally-closed EOS is public switch 83. ROM output 15 drives the flipper.
mechanisms.label: Lower-left flipper

mechanisms.behavior: The right cabinet button is public switch 82 and the normally-closed EOS is public switch 81. ROM output 16 drives the flipper.
mechanisms.label: Lower-right flipper

mechanisms.behavior: The Stern manual identifies D15 as the upper-right flipper button (public switch 86) and D16 as its normally-closed EOS (public switch 85). The exact table's embedded script asserts switch 86 from RightFlipperKey and registers ROM output 14 to solURFlipper/RightFlipper2; it does not assert switch 85. The EOS identity and normally-closed physical wiring therefore remain manual-authoritative.
mechanisms.label: Upper-right flipper

mechanisms.behavior: Output 19 pulses the 28-900 coil to shake the Green Goblin figurine. Switches 1-5 are the five vertically arranged Goblin target contacts; the embedded Spider-Man 3.0 VPX script extracted from the retained exact table binds output 19 to solGoblin and animates the figurine independently of the target pulses.
mechanisms.label: Green Goblin shaking figurine

physical.notes: Q5 is the 24 VAC motor/relay that moves the Doc Ock gate; the exact table uses the Octopus primitive as the shared assembly anchor for its two limit switches.
Q13 is the 24 VAC motor/relay that moves the Sandman gate; the exact table uses the Sandman primitive as the shared assembly anchor for its two limit switches.

Q19 is the Green Goblin motor/actuator in the Stern coil chart. The table's FlasherGoblin render helper is not counted as a second physical effect; the normalized effect point is the exact Goblin primitive anchor.

physical.location: US/non-Euro hardware: 32 playfield bulbs, 10 rear back-panel bulbs, and 2 coin-door bulbs on four fused GI circuits
physical.notes: Regional scope is explicitly US/non-Euro hardware. Manual page 121 gives brown=8, yellow=11, violet=13, and green=10 rear-panel bulbs plus 2 US coin-door bulbs; Euro hardware has 3 coin-door bulbs and is not represented by this quantity. The 42 playfield/rear placements are normalized to the exact VPX playfield coordinate convention; rear-panel bulbs are projected to y=0 and the two US coin-door bulbs remain quantity-only cabinet hardware. VPX GI collection members and lightmap helpers are synchronized render helpers, not extra physical sockets.
